steps.headline: 1. Website gets its own overview; App stays accessible.
steps.changed: App-only counts become Website and App tabs, with separate totals and filters.
steps.notice: Website visits and clicks are not people or completed installs.
steps.risk: Fake data; collection and backend are unbuilt.

steps.headline: 4. See visits, instructions opened, download clicks and the share of visits that clicked.
steps.changed: New website totals distinguish total clicks from visits with at least one click.
steps.notice: A repeated click increases clicks, but each page visit counts once in the rate.
steps.risk: Sample data only. These measurements do not identify people or confirm installs.

steps.headline: 2. Compare campaign interest and see which platforms receive download clicks.
steps.changed: New website view, with no prior website counterpart: campaign visits, clicks and visits that clicked, beside platform click shares.
steps.notice: Each visit counts once in the rate. The platform filter changes only the breakdown.
steps.risk: These are fake examples, not evidence of campaign performance.

steps.headline: 3. Give shared links a source and campaign name, then copy the finished link.
steps.changed: New builder, with no previous website view. Short hints explain where the link is shared and how to group it.
steps.notice: The finished link updates as you type; Copy link prepares it to share.
steps.risk: Preview themes omit external fonts and custom styling; the published appearance may differ.
